goal: Prevent peers from suppressing outbound private broadcast connections by returning transactions early
Close a timing side channel that allows adversaries to correlate and trace private transaction broadcasts
agreement: General agreement on the approach with code review approvals (vasild, mzumsande)
Concept approval as a streamlined alternative to PR #34707 (optout21)
Unaddressed suggestion: guard against integer underflow for future safety (vasild, optout21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it hardens transaction origin privacy against timing side channels in outbound relay
The attack vector is theoretical rather than an actively exploited network vulnerability
